name: chronicle
description: Turns a brief plus facts gathered from GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Datadog or pasted notes into an illustrated, interactive story page designed for its subject: a theme, progress bar, paper and words from the subject's world, checked against other pages so no two look alike, ink-and-watercolor drawings painted in code, editorial charts, maps, flows, diagrams, quizzes, and a source behind every number. Also makes standalone animations in the same style, including animated technical architecture diagrams, exported as SVG, HTML, PNG, GIF and MP4 for web pages, docs, chat and slides.
